picks.title: Could Surah Al-Ma'un Be Talking About You? | Surah al-Ma'un | Sheikh Mohamed Eid Almuhairi #AMAU
picks.summary: Reflect on Surah Al-Ma'un with Sheikh Mohamed Eid Almuhairi and uncover what it teaches about Salah, the Hereafter and how we treat people. ▶️ Watch more of this series on Tadabbur of the Qur'an: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQM1BksNs60k You may have memorised Surah Al-Ma'un. You may have recited it hundreds of times. But have you ever stopped to ask why Allah places these particular verses together? The Surah begins with the one who denies the Day of Recompense: someone harsh towards the orphan and unconcerned about the poor. Then comes a striking shift: "So woe to those who pray…"
picks.reason: Reflects deeply on Surah Al-Ma'un's ethical and spiritual lessons about faith and behavior.

picks.title: The Names of Allah That Explain Tawheed | Al-Ahad & Al-Wahid | #10 Allah's Names & Attributes #AMAU
picks.summary: You have probably recited "Qul huwa Allahu Ahad" (Surah al-Ikhlas) countless times. But what exactly does Al-Ahad mean? picks.reason: Clarifies the meaning of Allah's names Al-Ahad and Al-Wahid and their theological significance.

picks.showTitle: Quran in a Year+ (with Imam Saif Morad)
picks.title: Day 338- Be Patient, But Don’t Be Passive | Ahkaf 33-35, Muhammad 1-11
picks.summary: in todays episode, we reflect on Allah’s command to the Prophet ﷺ to remain patient like the messengers of firm resolve and not to rush what Allah has not yet brought about.As we enter Surah Muḥammad, we explore how the Qur’an regulates even the most difficult human realities through revelation, authority, and the limits Allah has set. We also reflect on why Allah tests people through one another, why faith cannot be built upon following whoever appears strongest, and what it truly means to support the cause of Allah.
picks.reason: Reflects on patience, divine testing, and faith's resilience through Quranic verses.

picks.title: Day 335- Are You Living Like You Will Meet Allah? | Jathiya 33-37, Al-Ahkaf 1-10

picks.title: Surah An-Nisaa: The Women - Verse 47 - Allah's Curse
picks.summary: In today's tafsir, we respond to critics of the Quran who claim that Muslims cannot agree on the meaning of its verses.  We examine the meanings behind the word "curse" and explore how God's blessings are often hidden behind life's difficulties.
picks.reason: Explores the meaning of divine curse and blessings in Quranic context with ethical implications.
